runner_limitations: This is an adapted discovery/execution collector, not Vitest's Node runner.
Only the eight listed compatible files were bundled; database, fake-timer, FS/process/browser and mock-transform suites are excluded, not passed.
The collector self-checks a deliberately failing assertion and rejects zero discovered cases.
Sandbox performance timing is zero-resolution here and does not establish task latency.
Cases overlap the scoped regression scenarios; do not sum these counts as unique workflow attempts.
environment: Cloudflare remote JavaScript sandbox; unchanged repository test bodies, actual @vitest/expect and @vitest/spy 4.1.11; adapted test collector, not the Vitest Node runner; no provider/cloud API calls
